Let's be real: AI agents are the future. They can perceive, plan, and execute actions using external tools like APIs and databases. They're like the ultimate intern, but with super-human speed.
The problem? They're also a security nightmare.
Traditional security models, like the ones we use in DevSecOps, are built on the idea of predictable behavior and least privilege. But AI, especially generative AI, is designed to be creative and flexible. This fundamental conflict is why a single, seemingly innocent user prompt can turn your helpful agent into a data-leaking, unauthorized-action-executing liability.
We need a new playbook. That playbook is AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM).
If you're a developer, you know DevSecOps. It's about securing the pipeline, the infrastructure, and the a…

articles.author: Allianza
articles.description:
Hello, developer community!
I am part of the team developing the Allianza Blockchain. DEV.to is the perfect place for us to dive into technical details, and that's exactly what we'll do.
Allianza was designed to solve two of the biggest infrastructure challenges in Web3: secure interoperability and quantum resistance.
Bridge-Free Interoperability
The model of custodial cross-chain bridges is the weak point of current security. To overcome this, we developed the ALZ-NIEV Protocol.
The ALZ-NIEV does not use intermediary custody. Instead, it uses Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZK) to perform Native Signature Validation.
How does it work?
Real Post-Quantum Security: QRS-3
The threat of quantum computing is real and imminent. Allianza implemented QRS-3 (Triple Quantum Protection), a system of Triple Structural Redundancy.
QRS-3 combines three different cryptographic structures to ensure that even if one is broken, the other two maintain security.
Algorithm
Validation requires 2 out of 3 signatures, ensuring that security does not depend on a single mathematical failure.
Conclusion and Invitation
Allianza is in production with all functionalities validated. We invite the developer community to analyze our architecture and give us technical feedback.
Resources for Developers:
• Technical Validation (Proofs and Implementation): https://www.allianza.tech/technical-validation
• Technical Whitepaper: https://www.allianza.tech/whitepaper
• Source Code: https://github.com/allianzatech/blockchainallianza
What are your thoughts on the need for Triple Structural Redundancy in a post-quantum environment? Leave your comment!
Suggested Tags: #blockchain #web3 #cryptocurrency #security #quantum
articles.title: Allianza: The Bridge-Free Architecture and Quantum Redundancy (QRS-3)
